title: CUT&RUN/CUT&TAG Analysis: Protein-DNA Interaction Mapping (IWC epigenetics, v0.19)

description.text: Complete CUT&RUN/CUT&TAG analysis workflow for paired-end sequencing data. Processes raw FASTQ files through adapter removal (cutadapt) and alignment (Bowtie2 with dovetail option enabled). Applies quality filtering (MAPQ ≥ 30, concordant pairs only), converts BAM to BED format, and performs peak calling using MACS2 with parameters optimized for the punctate signal profile characteristic of CUT&RUN/CUT&TAG experiments. Tags: CUTnRUN.
